music.title: The Specification
music.prompt: Slow industrial liturgy, 58 BPM, D minor. Processed male choir holding one sustained vowel, heavily reverbed as if in a stone hall. Bowed metal and a single struck anvil on the downbeat every four bars. Low analogue synth drone underneath. No percussion until halfway, then a slow heavy pulse like a press. Bleak, ceremonial, patient, unresolved. No melody.

music.title: Standing Orders
music.prompt: Quiet ambient industrial, 52 BPM, minor key. Low synth pad, distant processed choir far back in the mix, a soft mechanical tick every two bars, occasional bowed cymbal swell. Extremely restrained and repetitive, background music designed to be ignored. No drums, no melody, no build.

music.title: Four Houses
music.prompt: Tense minimal industrial, 72 BPM, minor. A ticking mechanical pulse throughout like a metronome in a metal case, muted pizzicato low strings, a single bell struck every eight bars, cold synth pad. Builds very slightly in density but never releases. Anticipatory, institutional, slightly threatening.

music.title: The Count
music.prompt: Slow processed choir and low strings, 54 BPM, minor, elegiac rather than triumphant. Sustained female and male voices in close harmony, deep room reverb, sparse struck metal. Ends on an unresolved suspended chord that does not fall home. Funereal, exhausted, dignified. No drums.

music.title: The Green
music.prompt: Warm quiet acoustic ambience with something wrong underneath, 56 BPM. Softly picked nylon guitar, dusty upright piano, distant birdsong, tape hiss. Underneath it a barely audible low synth drone and a single detuned note that recurs. Nostalgic and domestic on the surface, unsettling beneath. No percussion.

music.title: Reliquary
music.prompt: Cold sacred ambient, 60 BPM, D minor. Bowed vibraphone and bowed cymbal sustaining long tones, sparse wordless choir very distant, deep cathedral reverb, subtle low drone. Almost no rhythm, one soft heartbeat pulse every four bars. Reverent, cold, still, like a room where bodies are kept. Nothing percussive or bright.

music.title: Furnace
music.prompt: Industrial forge rhythm, 84 BPM, minor. Anvil and sheet metal percussion in a slow hammering pattern, low brass swells, the roar of a furnace as sustained noise underneath, distant chains. Muscular and hot but restrained, a working foundry rather than a battle. No synths, no melody.

music.title: Glasshouse
music.prompt: Damp fragile ambient, 66 BPM, unsettled. Glass harmonica and wet fingers on crystal rims, prepared piano with felt on the strings, dripping water, faint insect texture. Airy and humid with a lot of space. Gentle but not comforting. No drums, no bass.

music.title: Thousand Rooms
music.prompt: Restless fractured loop, 96 BPM, phrygian. Hammered santur and oud playing a short figure that never quite repeats the same way, frame drum and finger cymbals, a ticking clock, layered whispering voices low in the mix. Claustrophobic and endlessly deferring, music that refuses to finish its sentence. Dry and close, almost no reverb.

music.title: Laboratory
music.prompt: Decayed machine ambient, 58 BPM, atonal and drifting. Degraded tape loops wobbling in and out of pitch, a broken machine rhythm that stutters and drops beats, pure sine tones like test equipment, distant structural groans, heavy hiss and wow and flutter. Derelict, clinical, faintly organic. No melody, no drums.

music.title: Coldstore
music.prompt: Frozen military ambient, 68 BPM, minor. Distant muffled snare roll under everything, very low brass sustaining, howling wind, creaking ice, a single struck bell far away. Vast, cold and exposed, enormous reverb and empty space. Ominous but patient, no build, no melody.

music.title: ACHILLES / Wrath
music.prompt: Enormous slow war drums, 50 BPM, minor. Taiko and bass drum hits with huge space between them, low male choir chanting one syllable, deep brass drone. Every hit is colossal and unhurried. Crushing, inevitable, monumental. No melody, no cymbals.

music.title: PROMETHEUS / The Fire
music.prompt: Rising brass and fire, 76 BPM, minor. French horns and trombones climbing a figure that keeps ascending without arriving, a huge struck bell, roaring flame as a sustained noise floor, rattling chain. Exposed, blazing, relentless upward pressure. No drums beyond a low pulse.

music.title: NOAH / The Ark
music.prompt: Sustained pipe organ drone, 48 BPM, minor. Deep church organ holding a slow chord change, water lapping and dripping, distant creaking timber and rope, a low wordless choir beneath. Sealed, heavy, oppressively calm, the sound of a door being closed from the inside. No percussion, no melody.

music.title: SCHEHERAZADE / The Thousand
music.prompt: Frantic tremolo strings, 132 BPM, phrygian. High violins shivering, hammered santur racing underneath, a clock ticking far too fast, many overlapping whispered voices. Desperate, brilliant, running out of time. Thin and bright rather than heavy. No bass drum.

music.title: Fairview
music.prompt: Slow pastoral americana with dread underneath, 54 BPM, major with a minor turn. Fingerpicked acoustic guitar, brushed snare, pedal steel held long, a distant upright piano. Beneath it a sub bass drone that grows imperceptibly. Warm, ordinary, and quietly terrible. No build, no climax.

music.title: The Convocation
music.prompt: Four voice chamber tension, 64 BPM, minor, contrapuntal. Cello, clarinet, santur and organ each playing an independent line that will not agree, over a static low drone. The lines interrupt and talk over one another. Formal, circular, mounting. Near silence in the middle, then all four at once. No percussion.

music.title: Made
music.prompt: Clinical minimal horror, 50 BPM, atonal. Sine tones and test equipment beeps in slow sequence, a heart monitor, deep room tone, a single processed voice stretched beyond recognition. Almost silent for long stretches. Sterile, patient, obscene. No drums, no melody.

music.title: John Smith
music.prompt: A single plain melody, 56 BPM, minor, solo instrument. Unaccompanied cello playing a simple eight note phrase, repeated with tiny variations, close miked with almost no reverb. Occasionally a second voice joins in unison, never in harmony. Human, unadorned, stubborn. No backing, no drums, no production.

music.title: Jane
music.prompt: A single plain melody answered, 56 BPM, minor, two instruments. Solo violin playing an eight note phrase, then a cello answering it a fourth below. Close miked, no reverb, no accompaniment. The two lines finally meet in unison at the very end. Tender, restrained, unsentimental. No drums, no production.

music.title: Match start
music.prompt: Short dramatic sting. One enormous struck anvil hit with long metallic decay, a low brass stab underneath, processed choir gasp on top. Starts instantly at full force. No intro, no build up.

music.title: Victory
music.prompt: Short sting. Low male choir resolving upward onto a major chord that is slightly too dark to feel like a victory, one bell, sustained low brass. Restrained and weary rather than triumphant. Ends clean. No intro, no drums.

music.title: Defeat
music.prompt: Short sting. Low male choir falling onto a minor chord, one bell struck slightly flat, sustained low brass dying away. Resigned, quiet, final. Ends clean. No intro, no drums.

music.title: Crown taken
music.prompt: Short sting. A single enormous bell struck once, with a choir swelling underneath it and a low brass note rising into the decay. Ceremonial and ominous, a coronation nobody wanted. Starts immediately, ends clean. No drums.

music.title: Last stand
music.prompt: Tense short loop. High string tremolo held, a heartbeat kick drum slowly accelerating, a ticking mechanism, nothing else. Extremely sparse and airless. No melody, no resolution.

ambience.title: Reliquary
ambience.prompt: Field recording ambience, no music. A vast cold stone crypt: deep room tone, very distant dripping, occasional faint settling of masonry, a cold draught. Enormous natural reverb, almost silent. No instruments, no melody.

ambience.title: Furnace
ambience.prompt: Field recording ambience, no music. A working foundry: sustained furnace roar, distant hammering on metal, steam release hiss, chains shifting, low machinery hum. Hot, busy, industrial. No instruments, no melody.

ambience.title: Glasshouse
ambience.prompt: Field recording ambience, no music. A large humid Victorian greenhouse: water dripping onto leaves, faint insect hum, glass panes ticking as they expand, a distant ventilation fan, soft rain on glass overhead. No instruments, no melody.

ambience.title: Thousand Rooms
ambience.prompt: Field recording ambience, no music. A sprawling improvised settlement indoors: distant indistinct voices through thin walls, tarpaulin flapping, a generator running somewhere, footsteps on board, intermittent hammering. Close and dry, no reverb. No instruments, no melody.

ambience.title: Laboratory
ambience.prompt: Field recording ambience, no music. A gutted concrete research building: wind moving through broken floors, loose sheet metal knocking, a failing fluorescent ballast buzzing, distant structural groans, dripping water into a deep stairwell. No instruments, no melody.

ambience.title: Coldstore
ambience.prompt: Field recording ambience, no music. An exposed polar ice field: sustained howling wind over open snow, ice shelf cracking and settling deep below, loose snow hissing across a crust, a distant metal structure creaking in the cold. No instruments, no melody.
